title: Thai Cheese Toast
description: A fusion of Thai and comfort food, this dish features crispy toast topped with melted cheese, vibrant spices, and a hint of Brazilian flair.
instructions: 2. In a pan, heat coconut oil over medium heat.
3. Add sliced bell pepper and cook until tender, about 3 minutes.
4. Spread Thai red curry paste evenly over toasted bread.
5. Top bread with shredded cheese, cooked bell pepper, and a sprinkle of chili flakes.
6. Bake in the oven for 5-7 minutes, or until cheese is melted and bubbly.
7. Remove from oven and season with salt and black pepper to taste.
